title: Nourishing Smoky Uruguayan Gelatin Casserole
description: A savory, smoky casserole that sets with unflavored gelatin for a juicy, low‑fat meal‑prep favorite.
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium heat until cooked through, then drain excess fat.
Add the diced onion, minced garlic, and diced bell pepper to the skillet and sauté until vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, smoked paprika, liquid smoke, and dried oregano, cooking for 1 minute to bloom the spices.
Pour in the canned tomatoes and beef broth, bring the mixture to a simmer, then season with salt and pepper.
Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes to reduce the sauce slightly, stirring occasionally.
Bloom the gelatin by sprinkling it over the cold water and letting it sit for 5 minutes; then whisk it into the sauce until fully dissolved.
Transfer the sauce mixture to a 9x8 inch baking dish, spreading it evenly.
Fold the low‑fat Greek yogurt into the top of the casserole, creating a light coating.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes until the gelatin has set and the top is lightly browned.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
